paras.en: 9.4.1 Block Design. Section 7.1 introduces the Mamba-2 block, which has small modifications to the Mamba-1 block. These changes are partly motivated by the connection to attention and also by the goal of improving the scalability of Mamba-2. Table 4 ablates these architecture changes to the block, which occur outside of the core SSM layer. The ablations validate that parallel projections to create \(A, B, C, X\) save parameters and perform slightly better than Mamba’s sequential projections. More importantly, this modification is amenable to tensor parallelism at larger model sizes (Section 8). Additionally, the extra normalization layer also slightly improves performance. More importantly, preliminary experiments at larger scales observed that it also helps with training stability.
paras.zh: 9.4.1 块设计。第 7.1 节介绍了 Mamba-2 块，它对 Mamba-1 块做了少量修改，这些修改部分源于与注意力机制的联系，也部分出于提升 Mamba-2 可扩展性的目标。表 4 对核心 SSM 层之外发生的这些块架构改动进行了消融实验。消融结果验证了用于生成 \(A, B, C, X\) 的并行投影既节省参数，又比 Mamba 的顺序投影略好。更重要的是，这种修改在更大模型规模下适合张量并行（第 8 节）。此外，额外的归一化层也略微提升了性能。更重要的是，更大规模下的初步实验观察到它还有助于训练稳定性。

paras.en: 9.4.2 Head Structure. Section 7.2 describes how the dimensions of the B, C, and X projections can be viewed as a hyperparameter analogous to notions of multi-head attention and multi-query attention. We also showed how the original Mamba architecture is analogous to multi-value attention (Proposition 7.2), which was a choice that naturally developed from the state-space model point of view and was not previously ablated. Table 5 ablates choices of the multi-head structure for the Mamba-2 architecture. Strikingly, we find a large difference between multi-value and multi-query or multi-key head patterns, despite seeming very similar. Note that this is not explained by the total state size, which is the same for all of them (equal to \(HPN\) or the product of the number of heads, head dimension, and state dimension). We also compare to multi-head patterns where the numbers of C, B, X heads (analogous to Q, K, V) are equal. We compare against the standard multi-head pattern, as well as one with aggressive sharing where they all have only 1 head. Note that in the latter case, the model still has H different sequence mixers M, because each head still has a different A. When parameter matched, these multi-head patterns perform similarly to each other, in between the MVA and MQA/MKA patterns.
paras.zh: 9.4.2 头结构。第 7.2 节描述了如何将 B、C、X 投影的维度视为与多头注意力和多查询注意力概念类似的超参数。我们还展示了原始 Mamba 架构如何类似于多值注意力（命题 7.2），这一选择是从状态空间模型的角度自然发展而来的，此前未经过消融。表 5 对 Mamba-2 架构的多头结构选择进行了消融。令人惊讶的是，我们发现在多值与多查询或多键头模式之间存在很大差异，尽管它们看起来非常相似。注意，这并不能由总状态大小来解释，因为所有模式的总状态大小相同（等于 \(HPN\)，即头数、头维度和状态维度的乘积）。我们还比较了 C、B、X（类比于 Q、K、V）头数相等的多头模式。我们与标准多头模式以及一种激进共享模式（三者均只有 1 个头）进行了比较。注意，在后一种情况下，模型仍然有 H 个不同的序列混合器 M，因为每个头仍然有不同的 A。在参数匹配时，这些多头模式彼此表现相似，介于 MVA 与 MQA/MKA 模式之间。

paras.en: 9.4.3 Attention Kernel Approximations. Section 7.3 noted how SSD can be combined with ideas from the linear attention literature, such as various forms of kernel approximations. We ablate several variants of these suggested by previous works in Table 6. These include cosFormer (Qin, Weixuan Sun, et al. 2022), Random Feature Attention (H. Peng et al. 2021), and Positive Random Features (Performer) (Choromanski et al. 2021). We also ablate adding a normalization term, akin to the denominator of the softmax function in standard attention. We found that this introduced instabilities to most variants, but slightly improved performance for the ReLU activation function \(\psi\). Table 7 also tests more recent proposals to improve linear attention that involve expanding the feature dimension (Based (Arora, Eyuboglu, Zhang, et al. 2024) and ReBased (Aksenov et al. 2024)). These linear attention extensions aim to approximate the exp kernel with a quadratic approximation. ReBased also proposes to replace the QK activation function with a layer normalization; from an SSM-centric view we apply a normalization on top of (B, C) before applying the SSM function.

paras.en: We note that this technique has been independently proposed as the “QK-Norm” for softmax attention (Team 2024) and an “internal normalization” for Mamba (Lieber et al. 2024). Overall, Table 6 and Table 7 found that the kernel approximation methods we tried did not seem to improve over simple pointwise non-linear activation functions for \(\psi\). Thus our default settings for Mamba-2 used \(\psi(x) = \text{Swish}(x)\) to follow Mamba-1, but we suggest that removing this activation entirely may be a simpler choice that we did not extensively test. We emphasize however that SSD and vanilla linear attention differ in the inclusion of the 1-semiseparable mask \(L\), while the various linear attention methods in the literature were derived to approximate softmax attention without this term; thus, our negative results may be not unexpected.
paras.zh: 我们注意到，该技术已被独立提出，分别称为软注意力机制的“QK-Norm”（Team 2024）和 Mamba 的“内部归一化”（Lieber et al., 2024）。总体而言，表 6 和表 7 发现，我们尝试的核近似方法似乎并未比用于 \(\psi\) 的简单逐点非线性激活函数更好。因此，我们的 Mamba-2 默认设置沿用 Mamba-1，使用 \(\psi(x) = \text{Swish}(x)\)，但我们建议完全移除该激活函数可能是一个更简单的选择，只是我们尚未进行充分测试。然而，我们要强调，SSD 与普通线性注意力的区别在于引入了 1-半可分掩码 \(L\)，而文献中的各种线性注意力方法都是为了在没有该掩码的情况下近似软注意力而推导的；因此，我们的负面结果或许并不意外。

paras.en: The state space duality framework connects SSMs, structured matrices, and attention. We discuss in more depth the broader relations between SSD and these concepts. Drawing on ideas from each of these viewpoints, we also suggest several directions in which the SSD framework could be extended in future work.
paras.zh: 状态空间对偶（SSD）框架将 SSM、结构化矩阵和注意力机制联系起来。我们更深入地讨论 SSD 与这些概念之间更广泛的关系。利用这些视角中的每一种思想，我们还提出了 SSD 框架未来可以扩展的一些方向。

paras.en:
We finally highlight a growing body of recent and concurrent work that have developed sequence models very similar to Mamba and Mamba-2.

• RetNet (Y. Sun et al. 2023) and TransNormerLLM (Qin, Dong Li, et al. 2023) generalize Linear Attention using decay terms instead of a cumulative sum, and propose dual parallel/recurrent algorithms as well as a hybrid “chunkwise” mode. These algorithms can be seen as an instantiation of SSD where \A_t\ is time-invariant (constant for all \t\); in the SMA interpretation, the mask matrix \L\ would be a decay matrix \L_{i,j} = γ^{i-j}\. These models also differ architecturally in various ways. For example, since they were derived from an attention-centric perspective they preserve the multi-head attention (MHA) pattern; since Mamba-2 was derived from an SSM-centric pattern it preserves the multi-value attention (MVA) or multi-expand SSM (MES) pattern, which we show to be better (Section 9.4).

• GateLoop (Katsch 2023) concurrently proposed using input-dependent decay factors \A_t\, and developed the same dual quadratic form as in SSD which they call a “surrogate attention” form.

• Gated Linear Attention (GLA) (Yang et al. 2024) proposed a variant of linear attention with data-dependent gates, along with efficient algorithms to compute a chunkwise mode and hardware-aware implementations.

• HGRN (Qin, Yang, and Zhong 2023) introduced an RNN with input-dependent gates, which was improved to incorporate state expansion in HGRN2 (Qin, Yang, Weixuan Sun, et al. 2024).

• Griffin (De et al. 2024) and RecurrentGemma (Botev et al. 2024) showed that an RNN with input-dependent gating, combined with local attention, can be very competitive with strong modern Transformers. Jamba also showed that combining Mamba with a few layers of attention performs very well on language modeling (Lieber et al. 2024).

• xLSTM (Beck et al. 2024) improves the LSTM by adopting the idea of state expansion and other gating, normalization, and stabilization techniques.

• RWKV-4 (B. Peng, Alcaide, et al. 2023) is an RNN based on a different linear attention approximation (the attention-free Transformer (S. Zhai et al. 2021)). It has recently been improved to the RWKV-5/6 (Eagle and Finch) architectures (B. Peng, Goldstein, et al. 2024) by adopting the ideas of selectivity and state expansion.
paras.zh:
我们最后强调一系列近期和同期的工作,它们开发了与 Mamba 和 Mamba-2 非常相似的序列模型。

• RetNet (Y. Sun 等, 2023) 和 TransNormerLLM (Qin, Dong Li, 等, 2023) 通过使用衰减项而非累积和来推广线性注意力,并提出了并行/循环双算法以及混合“分块”(chunkwise)模式。这些算法可以被视为 SSD 的一种实例化,其中 \A_t\ 是时不变的(对所有 \t\ 为常数);在 SMA 解释中,掩码矩阵 \L\ 将是衰减矩阵 \L_{i,j} = γ^{i-j}\。这些模型在架构上也有多种不同。例如,由于它们是从注意力为中心的视角推导出来的,因此保留了多头注意力(MHA)模式;而 Mamba-2 是从 SSM 为中心的视角推导出来的,因此保留了多值注意力(MVA)或多扩展 SSM(MES)模式,我们在第 9.4 节表明后者更优。

• GateLoop (Katsch 2023) 同时提出了使用输入相关的衰减因子 \A_t\,并开发了与 SSD 相同的对偶二次形式,他们称之为“替代注意力”(surrogate attention)形式。

• 门控线性注意力(GLA)(Yang 等, 2024)提出了一种具有数据相关门控的线性注意力变体,以及计算分块模式的高效算法和硬件感知实现。

• HGRN (Qin, Yang, 和 Zhong, 2023) 引入了一种具有输入相关门控的 RNN,并在 HGRN2 (Qin, Yang, Weixuan Sun, 等, 2024) 中通过纳入状态扩展进行了改进。

• Griffin (De 等, 2024) 和 RecurrentGemma (Botev 等, 2024) 表明,具有输入相关门控的 RNN 结合局部注意力,可以与强大的现代 Transformer 具有很强的竞争力。Jamba 还表明,将 Mamba 与几层注意力相结合,在语言建模上表现非常好 (Lieber 等, 2024)。

• xLSTM (Beck 等, 2024) 通过采用状态扩展的思想以及其他门控、归一化和稳定技术改进了 LSTM。

• RWKV-4 (B. Peng, Alcaide, 等, 2023) 是一种基于不同线性注意力近似(即无注意力 Transformer, S. Zhai 等, 2021)的 RNN。最近通过采用选择性和状态扩展的思想,它已被改进为 RWKV-5/6 (Eagle 和 Finch) 架构 (B. Peng, Goldstein, 等, 2024)。

We proposed a theoretical framework based on well-studied classes of structured matrices that bridges the conceptual gap between SSMs and attention variants. This framework yields insights on how recent SSMs (e.g. Mamba) perform as well as Transformers on language modeling. Moreover, our theoretical tools provide new ideas to improve SSMs (and potentially Transformers) by connecting the algorithmic and systems advances on both sides. As a demonstration, the framework guides our design of a new architecture (Mamba-2) at the intersection of SSMs and structured attention.

### B Efficient Algorithms for the Scalar SSM Scan (1-SS Multiplication)

In this section, we flesh out various algorithms for computing the scalar SSM scan through the lens of structured matrix decompositions. The scalar SSM scan is defined as computing the recurrent part of the discrete SSM (7), in the case when \(N=1\) (i.e., \(A\) is a scalar). This is commonly used to compute SSMs recurrently; in particular, the case of structured SSMs where \(A\) is diagonally structured reduces to this operation, as in the S5 (J. T. Smith, Warrington, and Linderman 2023) and S6 (Gu and Dao 2023) models. The goal of this section is to support a central theme of this paper: efficient algorithms for sequence models can be viewed as structured matrix multiplication algorithms. The various matrix decomposition ideas we present here are related to the ideas used to derive fast SSM algorithms (Section 6), and are also directly used as a subroutine.

### B 标量 SSM 扫描的高效算法（1-SS 乘法）

在本节中，我们从结构化矩阵分解的角度，详细阐述计算标量 SSM 扫描的各种算法。标量 SSM 扫描定义为在 \(N=1\)（即 \(A\) 为标量）的情况下，计算离散 SSM（式 7）的循环部分。它通常用于循环地计算 SSM；特别是，当结构化 SSM 的 \(A\) 具有对角结构时，该计算会归结为这一操作，例如 S5（J. T. Smith, Warrington, and Linderman 2023）和 S6（Gu and Dao 2023）模型。本节的目标是支撑本文的一个核心主题：序列模型的高效算法可以被视作结构化矩阵乘法算法。我们在此展示的各种矩阵分解思想，与推导快速 SSM 算法（第 6 节）所用的思想相关，并且本身也被直接用作一个子例程。
